_description: All configurable thresholds with provenance. SOURCE types: official, literature, engineering_heuristic, learned_from_dataset

broken._source: official — kernel below three-fourths of whole-kernel length
broken._notes: Small broken pieces (< 1/4 of whole kernel length) tracked separately per standard

chalky._source: descriptive feature threshold only; not a chalky classification rule; requires calibration against labeled grains

red._source: engineering_heuristic — colour-based proxy for red cuticle coverage

dehusked._source: official concept — more than one-quarter surface covered with bran; method is visual proxy only

rice_gate._source: engineering heuristic with an experimental Logistic Regression artifact trained on synthetic feature vectors; probe tests are not real-world model validation.
rice_gate._notes: Gate decisions and thresholds are unchanged for Case 1/Case 2 compatibility. A detection counts as rice only when it meets the configured rice class and confidence threshold; foreign-matter classes remain separate. Neither the synthetic feature model nor probe tests establish real-image accuracy.

image_quality._source: engineering_heuristic — hard-failure criteria and score thresholds require calibration against human-rated images

sample_warning._source: engineering_heuristic — configurable statistical warning, not an official government threshold
